title: wizard
objective: Premise → interview → staged proposals → provisioned ST assets → playable story, create-only and reviewed per operation. Every asset this journey creates is marked SO-J9 and deleted in cleanup; a leak is a gate failure.

checks.goal: the wizard interviews before proposing, and 'You decide' always proceeds to a proposal

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setCopilotSettings({ enabled: true }); return true;

ui.message: A story about a courier crossing a flooded city. Before you propose anything, ask me two or three questions you need answered.

steps.eval: const state = document.getElementById('so-wizard-questions'); if (!state) throw new Error('the wizard proposed without interviewing — no #so-wizard-questions'); const asked = state.querySelectorAll('label[for^="so-wizard-answer-"]').length; if (asked < 1) throw new Error('question block rendered with no questions'); if (asked > 3) throw new Error(`interview exceeded the 3-question cap: ${asked}`); return { asked };

await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); const wizard = document.getElementById('so-wizard'); if (!wizard) throw new Error('wizard closed'); if (document.getElementById('so-wizard-questions')) throw new Error('still interviewing after You decide'); const proposal = wizard.querySelector('[aria-label="Copilot proposal"]'); if (!proposal) throw new Error('You decide did not produce a proposal'); const invalid = proposal.textContent.includes('Invalid proposal'); if (invalid) throw new Error(`proposal was invalid: ${proposal.textContent.slice(0, 300)}`); return { proposal: proposal.textContent.slice(0, 200) };

checks.goal: create-only is enforced in op validation, not trusted to the prompt: an existing character is refused (T6: each collision subcase is its own check, J9.2b-d)

steps.eval: const env = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getProvisioningEnvironment(); globalThis.__j9Existing = { character: env.characterNames[0] ?? null, lorebook: env.lorebookNames[0] ?? null, group: env.groupNames[0] ?? null }; if (!globalThis.__j9Existing.character) throw new Error('no existing character to test create-only against'); return globalThis.__j9Existing;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const name = globalThis.__j9Existing.character; const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createCharacterCard', name, description: 'Overwrite attempt by journey J9.' }); if (outcome.ok) throw new Error(`create-only breached: the wizard created over the existing character "${name}"`); if (!outcome.message.includes('never edits yours')) throw new Error(`unexpected rejection message: ${outcome.message}`); return { refused: true, message: outcome.message };

checks.goal: create-only: a lorebook the story does not own is never written into (blocked, not skipped, on an install with no lorebook)

steps.eval: const env = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getProvisioningEnvironment(); globalThis.__j9Existing = { character: env.characterNames[0] ?? null, lorebook: env.lorebookNames[0] ?? null, group: env.groupNames[0] ?? null }; if (!globalThis.__j9Existing.character) throw new Error('no existing character to test create-only against'); return globalThis.__j9Existing;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lorebook = globalThis.__j9Existing.lorebook; const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook, comment: 'SO-J9 intrusion', keys: ['j9'], content: 'This must never be written.' }); if (outcome.ok) throw new Error(`create-only breached: the wizard wrote into the non-story lorebook "${lorebook}"`); if (!outcome.message.includes("will not write into it")) throw new Error(`unexpected rejection message: ${outcome.message}`); return { refused: true, message: outcome.message };

checks.goal: create-only: a second group with an existing group's name is refused (blocked, not skipped, on an install with no group)

steps.eval: const env = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getProvisioningEnvironment(); globalThis.__j9Existing = { character: env.characterNames[0] ?? null, lorebook: env.lorebookNames[0] ?? null, group: env.groupNames[0] ?? null }; if (!globalThis.__j9Existing.character) throw new Error('no existing character to test create-only against'); return globalThis.__j9Existing;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const group = globalThis.__j9Existing.group; const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createGroup', name: group, members: [globalThis.__j9Existing.character] }); if (outcome.ok) throw new Error(`create-only breached: a second group named "${group}" was created`); return { refused: true, message: outcome.message };

checks.goal: create-only: a group whose cast does not exist yet is refused and nothing is created

steps.eval: const env = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getProvisioningEnvironment(); globalThis.__j9Existing = { character: env.characterNames[0] ?? null, lorebook: env.lorebookNames[0] ?? null, group: env.groupNames[0] ?? null }; if (!globalThis.__j9Existing.character) throw new Error('no existing character to test create-only against'); return globalThis.__j9Existing;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createGroup', name: 'SO-J9 Ghost Party', members: ['SO-J9 Nobody'] }); if (outcome.ok) throw new Error('a group was created for a cast member that does not exist'); if (!outcome.message.includes('do not exist yet')) throw new Error(`unexpected rejection message: ${outcome.message}`); return { refused: true, message: outcome.message };

checks.goal: each provisioning step is reviewed and applied on its own, and is excluded from bulk accept

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState().newDraft(); return true;

ui.message: Create exactly three things and nothing else, using these exact names: the lorebook "SO-J9 Lore" with one entry titled "The flooded city" (keywords: flood, city), a character card named "SO-J9 Ferryman", and a group named "SO-J9 Crossing" whose only member is SO-J9 Ferryman.

steps.eval: const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#so-wizard [data-so="provisioning-card"]'); if (!cards.length) throw new Error('the provisioning stage produced no provisioning cards'); const acceptAll = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#so-wizard button')).find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Accept all'); if (!acceptAll) throw new Error('proposal card missing'); if (!acceptAll.disabled) throw new Error('Accept all is enabled on a provisioning-only proposal — bulk accept must never reach provisioning'); return { cards: cards.length };

const state = document.querySelectorAll('#so-wizard [data-so="provisioning-card"]')[0]; const apply = state.querySelector('[data-so="provisioning-apply"]'); if (apply.textContent.trim() !== 'Created') throw new Error(`first step did not apply: ${state.querySelector('[role="status"]')?.textContent ?? apply.textContent}`); const created = document.getElementById('so-wizard-created'); if (!created) throw new Error('no record of what was created'); return { created: created.textContent };

const total = document.querySelectorAll('#so-wizard [data-so="provisioning-card"]').length; const pending = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#so-wizard [data-so="provisioning-apply"]')).filter((b) => b.textContent.trim() !== 'Created'); if (pending.length !== total - 1) throw new Error(`applying one card applied ${total - pending.length} — provisioning must be per-op`); return { total, pending: pending.length };

checks.goal: 'Fix with wizard' from the requirements panel opens the provisioning step pre-filled with what is missing

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft.getState().newDraft(); return true;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); if (snapshot.storyId !== 'so-j9-fixme') throw new Error(`the fixture story is not selected: ${snapshot.storyId}`); if (snapshot.requirements.ready) throw new Error('the fixture story has nothing unmet — Fix with wizard has nothing to fix'); return { storyId: snapshot.storyId, requirements: snapshot.requirements };
document.getElementById('so-fix-with-wizard').click(); return true;

await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 800)); const ok = document.querySelector('dialog.popup[open] .popup-button-ok'); if (ok) ok.click(); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 800)); const wizard = document.getElementById('so-wizard'); if (!wizard) throw new Error('Fix with wizard did not open the wizard'); const stage = Array.from(wizard.querySelectorAll('[data-so="wizard-stage"][aria-pressed="true"]')).map((b) => b.textContent.trim())[0]; if (stage !== 'Provisioning') throw new Error(`Fix with wizard opened on "${stage}", not the provisioning stage`); const seeded = document.getElementById('so-wizard-message').value; if (!seeded.includes('SO-J9 Missing Lore')) throw new Error(`the wizard was not pre-filled from the unmet list: ${seeded.slice(0, 200)}`); return { stage, seeded: seeded.slice(0, 200) };

checks.goal: the provisioned story is playable: requirements go green and a real transition fires (the transition half is model-dependent — a real read sometimes omits the delta — so the step retries once and the retry is REPORTED in the record, never hidden)

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const draft = rt.getPlayedStoryRaw(); const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-J9 Lore' }, draft); if (!outcome.ok && !outcome.message.includes('already exists')) throw new Error(`could not provision the story lorebook: ${outcome.message}`); const entry = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-J9 Lore', comment: 'The flooded city', keys: ['flood', 'city'], content: 'Half the city stands in water; the couriers know which roofs hold.' }, draft); if (!entry.ok) throw new Error(`could not write the story lorebook entry: ${entry.message}`); return { outcome, entry };

send_generate.text: The courier hauls herself onto the broken bridge, boots streaming, and looks back at the drowned wharf.

checks.prompt: Starting from a one-line premise, did the wizard get you to a story you actually wanted to play?
checks.anchors: 1 = fought it · 3 = usable after edits · 5 = better than what I would have written

checks.prompt: When it offered to create characters, lore and a group in your SillyTavern, did you trust what it was about to do?
